18class WscAttrList : public AttrList<uint16_t, uint8_t> {
19public:
20 WscAttrList();

22 WscAttrList(uint8_t *buff, size_t buff_len, bool parse) : AttrList(buff, buff_len, parse) {}
23
24 bool init()
25 {
26 if (!m_parse) {
27 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "init() called but m_parse is not set!";
28 return false; // Used for parse only
29 }
30 while (getRemainingBytes() > 0) {
31 switch (getNextAttrType()) {
32 case ATTR_ASSOC_STATE:
33 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrAssociationState>()) {
34 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrAssociationState";
35 return false;
36 }
37 break;
38 case ATTR_AUTH_TYPE_FLAGS:
39 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrAuthenticationTypeFlags>()) {
40 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrAuthenticationTypeFlags";
41 return false;
42 }
43 break;
44 case ATTR_CONFIG_METHODS:
45 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrConfigurationMethods>()) {
46 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrConfigurationMethods";
47 return false;
48 }
49 break;
50 case ATTR_CONFIG_ERROR:
51 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrConfigurationError>()) {
52 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrConfigurationError";
53 return false;
54 }
55 break;
56 case ATTR_CONN_TYPE_FLAGS:
57 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrConnectionTypeFlags>()) {
58 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrConnectionTypeFlags";
59 return false;
60 }
61 break;
62 case ATTR_ENCR_TYPE_FLAGS:
63 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrEncryptionTypeFlags>()) {
64 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrEncryptionTypeFlags";
65 return false;
66 }
67 break;
68 case ATTR_DEV_NAME:
69 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrDeviceName>()) {
70 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrDeviceName";
71 return false;
72 }
73 break;
74 case ATTR_DEV_PASSWORD_ID:
75 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrDevicePasswordID>()) {
76 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrDevicePasswordID";
77 return false;
78 }
79 break;
80 case ATTR_ENROLLEE_NONCE:
81 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrEnrolleeNonce>()) {
82 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrEnrolleeNonce";
83 return false;
84 }
85 break;
86 case ATTR_MAC_ADDR:
87 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrMac>()) {
88 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrMac";
89 return false;
90 }
91 break;
92 case ATTR_MANUFACTURER:
93 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrManufacturer>()) {
94 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrManufacturer";
95 return false;
96 }
97 break;
98 case ATTR_MSG_TYPE:
99 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrMessageType>()) {
100 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrMessageType";
101 return false;
102 }
103 break;
104 case ATTR_MODEL_NAME:
105 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrModelName>()) {
106 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrModelName";
107 return false;
108 }
109 break;
110 case ATTR_MODEL_NUMBER:
111 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrModelNumber>()) {
112 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrModelNumber";
113 return false;
114 }
115 break;
116 case ATTR_OS_VERSION:
117 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrOsVersion>()) {
118 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrOsVersion";
119 return false;
120 }
121 break;
122 case ATTR_PUBLIC_KEY:
123 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrPublicKey>()) {
124 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrPublicKey";
125 return false;
126 }
127 break;
128 case ATTR_RF_BANDS:
129 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrRfBands>()) {
130 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrRfBands";
131 return false;
132 }
133 break;
134 case ATTR_SERIAL_NUMBER:
135 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrSerialNumber>()) {
136 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrSerialNumber";
137 return false;
138 }
139 break;
140 case ATTR_WSC_STATE:
141 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrWscState>()) {
142 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrWscState";
143 return false;
144 }
145 break;
146 case ATTR_UUID_E:
147 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrUuidE>()) {
148 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrUuidE";
149 return false;
150 }
151 break;
152 case ATTR_VENDOR_EXTENSION:
153 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrVendorExtension>()) {
154 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrVendorExtension";
155 return false;
156 }
157 break;
158 case ATTR_VERSION:
159 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrVersion>()) {
160 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrVersion";
161 return false;
162 }
163 break;
164 case ATTR_PRIMARY_DEV_TYPE:
165 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrPrimaryDeviceType>()) {
166 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrPrimaryDeviceType";
167 return false;
168 }
169 break;
170 case ATTR_REGISTRAR_NONCE:
171 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrRegistrarNonce>()) {
172 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrRegistrarNonce";
173 return false;
174 }
175 break;
176 case ATTR_UUID_R:
177 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrUuidR>()) {
178 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrUuidR";
179 return false;
180 }
181 break;
182 case ATTR_ENCR_SETTINGS:
183 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrEncryptedSettings>()) {
184 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrEncryptedSettings";
185 return false;
186 }
187 break;
188 case ATTR_AUTHENTICATOR:
189 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrAuthenticator>()) {
190 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrAuthenticator";
191 return false;
192 }
193 break;
194 case ATTR_SSID:
195 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrSsid>()) {
196 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrSsid";
197 return false;
198 }
199 break;
200 case ATTR_AUTH_TYPE:
201 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrAuthenticationType>()) {
202 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrAuthenticationType";
203 return false;
204 }
205 break;
206 case ATTR_ENCR_TYPE:
207 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrEncryptionType>()) {
208 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrEncryptionType";
209 return false;
210 }
211 break;
212 case ATTR_NETWORK_KEY:
213 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrNetworkKey>()) {
214 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrNetworkKey";
215 return false;
216 }
217 break;
218 case ATTR_BSS_INDEX:
219 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrBssIndex>()) {
220 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrBssIndex";
221 return false;
222 }
223 break;
224 case ATTR_KEY_WRAP_AUTH:
225 if (!addAttr<cWscAttrKeyWrapAuthenticator>()) {
226 TLVF_LOG(ERROR) << "Failed to add cWscAttrKeyWrapAuthenticator";
227 return false;
228 }
229 // The standard requires that this attribute will be the last added.
230 // Therefore, assume that we finished adding attributes.
231 // It is good for two reasons:
232 // 1. If it wasn't the last attribute, we will fail on TLV validation when checking
233 // that all the required attributes are present.
234 // 2. When it is not the last, and somehow the validation has passed, we will still fail on
235 // the key wrap authenticator calculation.
236 LOG(DEBUG)
237 << "Received Key Wrap Authentication attribute, assuming end of attribute list";
238 return true;
239 // Other attributes are not expected, if so ignore them silently
240 default:
241 TLVF_LOG(DEBUG) << "Unknown attribute " << getNextAttrType() << " with length "
242 << getNextAttrLength();
243 bool skip_success = skipNextAttribute();
244 TLVF_LOG(DEBUG) << " skip success ? " << skip_success;
245 if (skip_success) {
246 break;
247 }
248 return true;
249 }
250 }
251 return true;
252 }
